note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I can’t proceed yet because the transcript and the differential diagnosis (DDx) content didn’t come through. In your message, the transcript and DDx appear as placeholders ({transcript} and {ddx}).

Please provide:
- The full transcript (doctor–patient conversation).
- The DDx in the exact format you have (JSON payload or a clear list of differential diagnoses).

Once received, I will produce:
- Subjective: current issues, HPI with onset/duration/progression, PMH, meds, social history, allergies.
- Objective: physical findings, vitals, relevant exam details, investigations with results (as applicable).
- Assessment & Plan:
  - Issue 1 (name): assessment, consistent DDx with likelihood tags if available, planned investigations, treatment, referrals.
  - Issue 2, 3, etc., as applicable.
  - Only include DDx items that are consistent with the transcript; if conflicts exist, I will include both with “conflict noted.”
- Quality checks: note any missing elements (allergies, meds), any internal conflicts, and any notes on transcript quality.

If you’d like, you can paste the transcript and DDx in the following format:
- Transcript: [paste text here]
- DDx: [paste JSON or bullet list here]

I’ll proceed immediately with the structured SOAP note in American English, using concise, professional bullet points and the exact structure you requested.
